description: The bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of different model configurations evaluated on two distinct datasets, labeled "PHEME" and "PolitiFact". The horizontal axis displays the categorical configurations, which are divided into two main panels separated by a dashed vertical line corresponding to the two datasets. Within each panel, the categories are ordered from left to right as "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", with the text labels rotated slightly for readability. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from just below 75.0 to 95.0, with numeric tick marks placed at regular intervals of 2.5 from 75.0 to 95.0. The chart features grouped bars, where each dataset panel contains a set of six adjacent bars corresponding to the horizontal axis categories. Each category is represented by a specific color: "Ours" is dark red, "w/o comments" is orange, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue-grey, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. All bars are outlined in black and are visually emphasized with their exact numerical values annotated in bold text directly above them. In the PHEME group, the "Ours" bar is the tallest at 89.84, while the "w/o text" bar is the shortest at 80.10; the remaining bars are 86.82 ("w/o comments"), 88.80 ("w/o select"), 87.34 ("w/o emotion"), and 87.17 ("w/o cognition"). Similarly, in the PolitiFact group, the "Ours" bar is the tallest at 90.57, and the "w/o text" bar is the shortest at 83.02, with the other bars measuring 85.85 ("w/o comments"), 89.62 ("w/o select"), 84.91 ("w/o emotion"), and 87.74 ("w/o cognition"). The bars are not sorted by height but follow a consistent categorical order in both panels, and the dataset names are emphasized in large, bold text at the top of their respective sections against a background with faint horizontal grid lines.
